name: desmin

function.text: DES encodes desmin. Annotated molecular activities include structural constituent of cytoskeleton and cytoskeletal protein binding. It participates in cytoskeleton organization and muscle contraction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to dilated cardiomyopathy 1I (autosomal dominant); myofibrillar myopathy 1 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

function.text: DES encodes desmin. Based in part on similarity, it contributes to maintaining the structure of sarcomeres, inter-connecting the Z-disks and forming the myofibrils, linking them not only to the sarcolemmal cytoskeleton, but also to the nucleus and mitochondria, thus providing strength for the muscle fiber during activity. It is required for nuclear membrane integrity, via anchoring at the cell tip and nuclear envelope, resulting in maintenance of microtubule-derived intracellular mechanical forces. It contributes to the transcriptional regulation of the NKX2-5 gene in cardiac progenitor cells during a short period of cardiomyogenesis and in cardiac side population stem cells in the adult.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with dilated cardiomyopathy 1I (autosomal dominant); myofibrillar myopathy 1 (autosomal dominant).
